description: Escultura de cintas continuas entrelazadas, tramado marfil sobre carbón con acentos cobre. Pieza conceptual para la identidad personal; no es una captura de producto.
prompt: Create an original high-end editorial web hero artwork for a software engineer, QA and systems portfolio. Portrait aspect ratio 4:5. A striking large sculptural toroidal knot made of intricately stacked, thin architectural ribbons, winding into a single continuous impossible loop, with an open dark center, evokes systems and continuous learning. Isometric three-quarter view, sculpture floating weightlessly. Beautiful complex physical form, like a museum scientific sculpture engraved by an old computer. Render the entire sculpture in fine ivory stipple/halftone and ordered dither dots, rich layered depth, top-left directional lighting, very dark charcoal shadows, sparse subtle copper highlights on select edges. Strict warm black #10110f background and warm ivory #e8e3d5 material, minimal copper #c89b6e. The right 80% of the composition holds the full sculpture, ample dark negative space at edges. Full object visible uncropped, large subject, no pedestal. Sophisticated retro computing print aesthetic, analog grain, precise geometry, cinematic chiaroscuro. No text, no logos, no UI, no borders, no neon, no colored gradients, no additional objects. This is an actual image asset, not a screenshot or website mockup.
